component.name: Bluetooth Wake
component.summary: Choose which Bluetooth devices can wake the computer

description.p: A bumped Bluetooth mouse or a controller turning on can wake a suspended computer. Bluetooth Wake lists your paired and connected devices and lets you switch off, per device, whether each one may wake the system.

ul.li: Per-device wake toggle for mice, keyboards and game controllers
Warns when the Bluetooth controller itself cannot wake the system
Warns when Bluetooth is turned off
Updates live as devices connect, disconnect or are paired

description.p: Only input devices support this setting. Some adapter firmware ignores it; in that case wakeup must be disabled for the whole USB controller.

screenshot.caption: List of Bluetooth devices with wake toggles
